items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: I could kind of sight read Mozart

ctx.x: Um hum. There’s a lot to be said for playing by ear, isn’t there?

Absolutely, yeah, yeah. It’s really one of those things where I’m really glad I had that — I wish I had been a little more disciplined about reading because it was one of those things where I tried to hear it and I talked about — I was explaining once about I could never be ear-blind. There was a teacher when I was about 16 I went to study with a wonderful teacher named Dolores Spitzer who had me sight read something that was on the piano. And after a couple of bars she said, “You don’t read, do you?” And she…
